body:
ONE-PAGE CONCEPT NOTE

Solicitation: CyberAICorps Scholarship for Service
Opportunity number: 26-503
Agency: NSF
Status / close: posted / 07/20/2027

Problem and fit
This concept addresses the solicitation's cybersecurity and resilient infrastructure theme with an evidence-gated agent workflow that refuses unverified actions and emits auditable receipts. The design starts from artifacts that already run—the public 21-game HTML5 portfolio and the Gen-133 evidence-gated agent forge—then limits the funded work to a domain-specific pilot, formal evaluation, and reproducible handoff.

Proposed aims
1. Translate the notice's target workflow into a bounded task model, data inventory, and risk register.
2. Build a minimal browser-accessible pilot with retrieval/provenance, explicit human approval, and a refused-action path.
3. Evaluate the pilot on held-out cases and publish a sanitized reproducibility package appropriate to the notice.

Deliverables
- Requirements and eligibility matrix mapped to the full notice.
- Working pilot with operator-gated effects and append-only receipts.
- Evaluation set, failure analysis, and deployment/non-deployment recommendation.
- Final technical report and reusable public-interest components where the award permits.

Evaluation
Primary measures: detection precision, false-positive rate, mean time to verified response, policy violations. A successful pilot must improve the target workflow without hiding unsupported claims, privacy gaps, or reviewer overrides.

Existing proof and requested next step
Portfolio: https://hfo-games.pages.dev/. Suika variants: https://hfo-suika-dlc-1-norse.pages.dev/ and three companion deployments. Forge: https://github.com/TTaoGaming/hfo-gen-133. Before any application, verify applicant type, geographic eligibility, cost share, indirect-cost rules, required registrations, and the complete notice. This concept note does not claim eligibility or award availability beyond the public Grants.gov search record.
